# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Satan's Story — Why He Refused to Worship Adam

---

**5:1** And Adam said to the devil: 'Why do you fight against us? What have we done to you? Why do you pursue us with craft and envy?'

**5:2** And the devil answered with a great sigh: 'Adam, all my enmity and envy and sorrow are on account of you, for it is because of you that I was cast out of heaven and expelled from the company of the angels.'

**5:3** And Adam said to him: 'What have I done to you? What blame is mine? For you have not been harmed by me in any way.'

**5:4** The devil replied: 'When you were created, I was cast out. For when God breathed into you the spirit of life and your face and form were made in the image of God, Michael brought you and made you worship before God in the sight of all the angels, and God said: "Worship Adam." And I worshiped you.'

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
